API Reference

SeisMonitor provides tools for seismic monitoring workflows, including waveform handling, downloading, phase picking, association, event location, and magnitude estimation.

Core

Main objects.

Core
Downloader

Download waveform data from providers.

Downloader
Picker

Automatic phase picking workflows.

Picker
Associator

Earthquake phase association tools.

Associator
NonLinLoc Locator

Earthquake location tools using NonLinLoc.

Nlloc
Magnitude

Magnitude estimation methods.
